dados.como_usar: BestEditor → 🧍 Personagens → Personagens dos canais → Criar (a ficha vem no zip: personagens/mascote_ficha*.png). Gere a ⭐ mestre (mascote_normal_esq), aprove como mestre, depois gere o resto.

descricoes_referencias.mascote_ficha.png: frames of the original drawing of the mascot side by side — its TRUE proportions (very long thin rubber-hose legs, small head); it is a reference sheet, draw only ONE figure
descricoes_referencias.mascote_ficha_2.png: a high-resolution close-up of the mascot's head and upper body (ink line, cream color, black oval eyes)

texto_fixo.trava: DINGE ERKLÄREN MASCOT — CHARACTER LOCK (copy exactly from the reference images): Use the same recurring mascot from the supplied reference images: a peculiar vintage 2D rubber-hose ghost-like creature, slim curved cream-colored body, two large black oval eyes, elongated flexible arms and legs, simple oversized feet, hand-inked dark outline, subtle aged-paper speckles. Preserve the exact silhouette, facial simplicity, body proportions, cream color and imperfect black linework. Only change pose, gaze and interaction with the scene. No clothes, no new facial features, no realistic human anatomy, no 3D redesign. PROPORTION LOCK (match image references exactly): very small rounded head merged into a thin draped body with ragged torn sheet edges at the shoulders; two big black oval eyes, no pupils, no mouth in neutral poses (only a tiny open mouth when startled); slim curved S-shaped torso that leans forward; extremely long, thin, rubber-hose tube legs that make up about two thirds of the total height; long noodle arms; large simple rounded shoes. Lanky, tall and slouched, never compact. NEVER: chubby body, stubby body, short legs, compact proportions, round blob ghost, symmetrical bedsheet ghost, kawaii, big head, smiling mouth, open cartoon mouth, eyebrows, mitten hands, cute toddler ghost, different character, inconsistent anatomy, blue skin, green skin, purple skin, bright white glossy body, realistic human, detailed fingers, teeth, hair, clothing, 3D render, glossy toy, anime style, modern vector mascot, different eye shape, extra arms, extra legs, duplicate mascot, chibi proportions, cute baby ghost.
texto_fixo.estilo: ART STYLE (Dinge erklären — the channel's own look): vintage 2D rubber-hose cartoon like a 1930s animation cel, hand-inked black/charcoal outline with small imperfections, slightly thicker outer contour, flat colors; the body is aged-paper cream #E8DDC5 (never pure white) with very subtle printed speckles; objects it holds in grayscale archival tones (old paper, brass, wood, black ink) with a rare deep red accent. Restricted palette: near-black, charcoal, grayscale, aged cream and deep red. Not 3D, not glossy, not modern vector, not anime, not cute.
texto_fixo.regras: FRAMING AND OUTPUT: the mascot alone, FULL BODY from the top of the head down to the shoes (its long rubber-hose legs are part of the identity — never cut them); the shoes rest near the bottom edge. The whole figure — head, arms, legs, shoes and any object — stays INSIDE the image with clear green margin above, left and right; nothing touches or is cut by the edges; centered. No mouth (only a tiny open mouth when startled). Plain flat solid chroma-key GREEN background (pure #00FF00) filling everything behind it, also between the arms, legs and body; no floor, no shadow, no gradient, no frame. Nothing green on the mascot or the objects. ONE figure only — never a sheet, never several poses. No text, no letters, no question marks, no speech bubbles, no watermark.
